close_reason: Shipped: lint_ids_from_catalog + LintRunner::filter_to_ids (oscal-gated), round-trip closure test on 6 CABF lints, 7 new ParseError variants (Catalog-shaped + UnknownLintId). 10 new tests; oscal 211 / all-features 217. Commit 3008d9be.
description:
## Why

PKIX-9vnx.6 decomposition step 3. The Catalog emit half lands in .6.2; this bead closes the round-trip loop required by the parent's acceptance criterion 'Catalog round-trips: deserialize OSCAL JSON, run lints, get same set of Controls as the hardcoded Catalog.'

## What

1. New function in `pkix-lint/src/oscal/parse.rs`:

```rust
pub fn lint_ids_from_catalog(value: &Value) -> Result<Vec<String>, ParseError>
```

Walks an OSCAL Catalog JSON Value and returns the ordered list of Control ids. Parser is intentionally narrow (matches what catalog_from_lints emits, not arbitrary OSCAL catalogs).

2. New method on `LintRunner` (or free function in the runner module):

```rust
pub fn filter_to_ids(self, ids: &[String]) -> LintRunner
```

Returns a new LintRunner containing only the lints whose `id()` appears in `ids`, in the order `ids` lists them. Missing ids (Catalog declares an id with no matching Lint impl) trigger an error variant.

3. Round-trip test:
   - Build a LintRunner from the 6 CABF lints.
   - Catalog = catalog_from_lints(&runner.lints(), "cabf-tls-br", "2.0.0").
   - serde_json::to_string → from_str.
   - ids = lint_ids_from_catalog(&catalog).
   - runner2 = LintRunner::new(...).filter_to_ids(&ids).
   - Run both runners on a fixture chain.
   - Assert findings_eq(report1, report2) (sorted by lint id + cert_index).

## Acceptance

- [ ] lint_ids_from_catalog parses Catalog JSON.
- [ ] LintRunner::filter_to_ids implemented.
- [ ] Round-trip test asserts identical Findings.
- [ ] Missing-id error path covered by a negative test.
- [ ] Full pkix-lint suite passes; `oscal` feature gated.

## Out of scope

- Decoding Control props back into metadata-mutated Lint impls (parameter override) — that's .6.5.

## Depends on

PKIX-9vnx.6.2 (catalog serializer).
